subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main WSL2/Docker reproduction of the secondary-agent global-scope heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection and reporter evidence support the bug, but global session-store behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the issue is already marked for live repro and maintainer review.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route on current main, then queue a narrow fix against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source-backed failure path and let a repair PR add the missing global-scope target-agent coverage without live proof first.

options.title: Fold into session-routing review
options.body: Keep the issue open but handle it with broader global session and `dmScope` routing work if maintainers want one compatibility pass.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route on current main, then queue a narrow fix against the confirmed path.
